title: Building in Public: My GitHub Project Portfolio
description: A walkthrough of my open-source projects spanning churn analytics, causal inference, experimentation frameworks, and enterprise-grade data platforms.
contents:
Over the past few years I have been building a portfolio of production-grade data science and analytics systems — publicly available on GitHub. Each project is designed not as a toy example, but as a deployable, enterprise-ready framework.
1. Churn Analytics SaaS
github.com/witttingtorch/churn-analytics-saas
A full PostgreSQL-backed SaaS platform combining retention modelling, survival analysis, and customer lifetime value estimation. Rather than treating churn as binary classification, it models time-to-churn for far more actionable intelligence.
Key methods: Kaplan-Meier estimator, Cox proportional hazards, LTV modelling, PostgreSQL backend.
2. A/B Testing & Senior Experimentation Framework
github.com/witttingtorch/ab-testing-senior-experimentation
Built to senior experimentation standards — covering pre-experiment power analysis, sequential testing, variance reduction, and correct multiple comparison corrections.
Key methods: Sequential testing, CUPED variance reduction, Bonferroni & BH corrections, power analysis.
3. Bayesian Incrementality & Geo-Lift
github.com/witttingtorch/bayesian-incrementality-geo-lift
A Bayesian geo-lift framework using geographic regions as treatment and control units to estimate true incremental marketing impact — independent of platform-reported metrics.
Key methods: Bayesian causal inference, geo-based experimentation, posterior inference.
4. Customer Lifetime Value Platform
github.com/witttingtorch/customer-lifetime-value-platform
A production-grade CLV platform built with SQL, Python, R, Docker, and Kubernetes — designed to scale to enterprise data volumes with full containerised deployment.
Key methods: BG/NBD model, Gamma-Gamma spend model, Docker + Kubernetes deployment.
5. Funnel & Growth Analytics Platform
github.com/witttingtorch/funnel-growth-analytics-platform
A FAANG-style funnel analytics platform modelling the full user journey from acquisition through retention and revenue, with cohort tracking and drop-off analysis.
Key methods: Funnel analysis, cohort analysis, AARRR framework, full-stack data pipeline.
6. Observability One
github.com/witttingtorch/observability-one
An enterprise-grade observability platform with RCA, OpenTelemetry integration, and multi-vendor support — critical infrastructure for organisations running complex data pipelines in production.
Key methods: OpenTelemetry, RCA algorithms, distributed tracing.
What Ties These Projects Together
Each project reflects a consistent philosophy: production-grade over proof-of-concept. The goal is not to demonstrate that a technique works on a toy dataset, but to build systems that could be deployed in a real organisation tomorrow.
Full portfolio: github.com/witttingtorch
